fairness_rule: All manuscript-facing model families are evaluated on the same 20 new seeds, with the same simulation, split, target, horizon, and event-scoring semantics inherited from the frozen publication configuration.
execution_rule: The launcher must verify that every seed is absent from prior configs and outputs, that PyTorch is available, and that no neural row uses a surrogate backend.
completion_rule: Complete only when all 14 configured models are present for every one of the 20 seeds and all nine neural rows report Model_Backend=pytorch. Partial results must not be aggregated or cited.
claim_rule: This is a post-review fairness extension, not a replacement for or rerun of the original locked EAAI confirmatory test. The original locked evidence remains immutable.
